proposed_future_protocol.objective: One Settings startup and visual-evidence baseline on retained iOS27 target, with explicit launch and no deliberate permission configuration.
proposed_future_protocol.flow_candidate:
appId: com.apple.Preferences
---
- extendedWaitUntil:
    visible: Settings
    timeout: 5000
- takeScreenshot: settings-probe-1
proposed_changes: Review and pin a single externally supervised simctl launch of com.apple.Preferences before an assertion/screenshot-only Maestro flow. Do not issue launchApp, setPermissions, clearState or clearKeychain within Maestro.
Use T2 registered debug-log discovery and V1 pure command/hierarchy analyzer in a newly derived operator; do not edit the frozen P3 operator.
Bind exact app/device/runtime/tool/input hashes and command/log/screenshot artifacts to the new invocation. Bound log inputs before parsing; preserve original timestamps and unmodified raw logs.

Reject missing or malformed evidence, unsupported command sequences, failed commands, and absent completed Preferences hierarchy within the assertion window. A completed title selector alone cannot pass.

Report completion as pending visual review, not passed. Root must inspect the bound PNG and confirm Settings title plus substantive Settings content such as General and Accessibility, without blank/transition-only output. No user confirmation is needed for routine root visual review.

Retain and reconcile explicit permission operations from logs; never claim old or new permission state unchanged without before/after evidence. Do not reset/revoke historical grants from an unknown baseline.

Keep prior 420s total including60s cleanup, 240s flow including30s owned cleanup, 30scontrol/5shost caps, 20GiB beforeboot/flow, oneboot/control/flow and firstfailure stop. Budget an external launch inside existing work limit; no automatic retry or longer timeout.
No TableUs install/launch, newdevice, cleanup, live provider, downstream flow or deployment. Existing native approvals remain consumed.
remaining_before_approval_request: Finish static review of the assertion-only driver initialization/permission path; permissions:{} is not a proven no-op.
Implement, mock-test and freeze a new bounded operator/launch plan with explicit launch cap and cleanup ownership; no executable native operator is prepared by this design.
Verify the exact operator/input archive and fresh capacity/device-state preflight requirements, then present one concrete approval request.

Changing launch ordering is a proposed diagnostic design, not a validated fix or cross-OS acceptance transfer.

limitations: No matched accessibility node or pixel-render cause was retained; blank screenshot cause remains unresolved.
